lastCompletedStory.title: Add a free-text 'custom / enter id' passthrough to the config model picker

nextStoryContext: US-002 added a 'custom / enter id' sentinel row to the per-phase model Select (PHASE_MODEL_OPTIONS = [...MODEL_OPTIONS, CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION]), which reveals an ink-text-input TextInput (via a new useCustomModelEntry hook) instead of adding a text-mode to Select.tsx itself (Select.tsx was intentionally left untouched, per the story's own notes). The typed value is trimmed and stored verbatim through the same commitModel(phase, value) closure the normal alias path uses, so no allowlist exists anywhere in this flow. config.ts's mergeConfigChoices/readPhaseModel needed zero changes (confirmed already-verbatim in US-001). No further model-picker work is queued; if a future story revisits Select.tsx generically (e.g. adding a text-entry mode to the reusable component itself, rather than the CustomModelInput hook lived in ConfigScreen), the useCustomModelEntry hook in ConfigScreen.tsx is the reference implementation to generalize from.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed TextInput's public API: value/onChange/onSubmit/placeholder/focus props, and that onSubmit(value) fires with the current input value when Enter is pressed -- matches the CustomModelInput implementation exactly (no separate useInput handler needed for confirm, only for Esc-to-back-out).
